key_difference: On EBUSY, (D) explicitly releases the native lock (flock LOCK_UN / F_UNLCK) and retries the unlink while the fd is still open, rather than closing the fd first like (B); (D) also retries only on EBUSY (not ETXTBSY/EPERM), keeps unlock() and removeStaleLock() on separate paths instead of sharing one releaseLockFile() helper, and treats ENOENT/ENOTDIR from the retry as failure in removeStaleLock().
